item.title: At the playground
item.description: Name playground equipment, say where it is, and talk about how children play and wait for their turn.

children.definition: A long, smooth piece of playground equipment that children sit on to go from high to low.
children.example: Mila waits at the top of the slide until the child below moves away.

children.definition: A playground seat that hangs from above and moves forward and back.
children.example: My child sits on the swing and asks me for a little push.

children.definition: A long piece of playground equipment with a seat at each end. One end goes up when the other goes down.
children.example: The two children sit at different ends of the seesaw.
children.translation_uz: bir uchi koʻtarilganda ikkinchi uchi tushadigan argʻimchoq

children.definition: A tower in a playground that children can climb and play on.
children.example: From the top of the play tower, Lina can see her dad below.
collocations: the top of the play tower

children.definition: A round platform that children sit or stand on while it turns in place.
children.example: The children wait for the roundabout to stop before they get on.

children.definition: A flat part of a set of stairs or a ladder that you put your foot on.
children.example: Her dad puts one foot on the bottom step of the play tower.

children.definition: To go up something using your hands and feet.
children.example: Ravi can climb the rope to reach the play tower.

children.definition: To use your hands to make something move away from you.
children.example: Can you push the swing a little more slowly?

children.definition: To use your hands to make something come toward you.
children.example: I pull the empty swing toward me so my child can sit down.

children.definition: To do something one person at a time so each person can do it.
children.example: The children take turns on the swing. Leo goes first and Aya goes next.

children.definition: To stand one behind another, usually while waiting.
children.example: The children line up at the steps to the slide.
I stand next to the slide so I can help my child at the bottom.

children.definition: A tube in a playground that is open at both ends so children can go through it.
children.example: I wait at the other end of the tunnel while my child crawls through.

children.definition: To move on your hands and knees.
children.example: We have to crawl through the low tunnel to get to the other side.
